verdict.rationale: Avalara ships its own AI layer, the Avalara Avi Agent. Its docs describe AI-assisted explanations of how and why tax was calculated (jurisdiction breakdowns, sourcing decisions, exemption status, compliance rules), conversational queries over transactions, and AI tax-code recommendations built on its own rule and nexus data. That covers the core 'why did this invoice tax this way' and taxability questions. Missing for 10: any evidence that answers include citations to the underlying rules or statutes, detail on direct 'is this product taxable in this state' Q&A, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Avi Agent's answer quality.
